syzygium.definition: n a tropical evergreen tree of the myrtle family native to the East Indies but cultivated elsewhere
syzygium.translation: [医] [器官]融合, 融合虫, 融合体

syzygium aromaticum.translation: [网络] 丁香；桃金娘科植物丁香；丁香苞

syzygium jambolanum.translation: [医] 印度蒲桃, 海南蒲桃

syzygy.definition: n. the straight line configuration of 3 celestial bodies (as the sun and earth and moon) in a gravitational system

n. 一对事物, 朔望
[医] [器官]融合, 融合虫, 融合体(昔时推测由几个幼虫融合而成)
